Objective: Customer can register with valid details
Preconditions: Customer is not already registered; registration page available
Test Steps: Enter valid name, email, password and required details; submit
Expected Result: Account is created and confirmation is shown

Objective: Registered customer can authenticate
Test Steps: Enter valid credentials and sign in
Expected Result: Customer is authenticated and reaches the appropriate page

Objective: Invalid credentials are rejected
Test Steps: Enter invalid credentials and submit
Expected Result: Authentication is rejected without exposing sensitive information

Objective: Customer can browse available products
Test Steps: Open storefront and browse catalogue
Expected Result: Products are displayed with required information

Objective: Customer can search and view product details
Test Steps: Search for a known product and open its details
Expected Result: Relevant results and product details are displayed

Objective: Customer can add an available product to cart
Test Steps: Open product and add it to cart
Expected Result: Product appears in cart with correct quantity and price

Objective: Customer can update quantity and remove items
Test Steps: Change quantity, then remove item
Expected Result: Cart totals update correctly and item can be removed

Objective: Customer can create an order from a valid cart
Test Steps: Proceed to checkout and confirm order
Expected Result: Unique order is created with correct items and total

Objective: System prevents ordering unavailable quantity
Test Steps: Attempt to order more than available stock
Expected Result: Order is blocked and a clear message is shown

Objective: Customer can initiate test payment
Preconditions: Valid order exists; payment stub available
Test Steps: Start payment for order
Expected Result: Payment transaction is created and order enters correct payment state

Objective: Successful payment results in correct order state
Test Steps: Return successful payment result from test adapter
Expected Result: Order is marked paid and inventory/payment states remain consistent

Objective: Payment timeout does not create split-brain state
Test Steps: Simulate payment timeout
Expected Result: Order/payment/inventory remain in a defined consistent state

Objective: Failed payment is handled correctly
Test Steps: Simulate failed payment
Expected Result: Order is not incorrectly marked paid and user receives appropriate feedback

Objective: Duplicate payment result is handled idempotently
Test Steps: Submit same payment callback/result twice
Expected Result: Payment is processed once and no duplicate stock/order update occurs

Objective: Customer can view own orders
Test Steps: Open order history
Expected Result: Only the customer's orders are displayed

Objective: Admin can manage products
Test Steps: Create/update a product
Expected Result: Product changes are saved and visible as appropriate

Objective: Admin can view and update orders
Test Steps: Open order and update status
Expected Result: Order status is updated and persisted

Objective: Operational events are visible without sensitive data
Test Steps: Perform representative actions and inspect logs/dashboard
Expected Result: Relevant events appear; passwords/PINs/tokens are not exposed

Objective: Customer cannot access admin functions
Test Steps: Attempt to access admin endpoint/page
Expected Result: Access is denied

Objective: Sensitive values are not written to logs
Test Steps: Perform authentication/payment actions and inspect logs
Expected Result: No passwords, PINs, or secrets are present

Objective: Failed mandatory tests prevent successful deployment
Test Steps: Introduce a controlled failing test and run pipeline
Expected Result: Pipeline fails and does not promote the invalid build

Objective: Application stack can be started using approved container configuration
Test Steps: Build/start web, API and database services
Expected Result: Services start and communicate successfully

Objective: REQ-WL-06 is implemented and verified
Test Steps: Execute the mapped workflow and review RTM
Expected Result: Requirement has implementation and passing verification evidence

Objective: Logs support troubleshooting without sensitive information
Test Steps: Trigger representative success/error events
Expected Result: Logs contain useful diagnostic information and no sensitive data
